_readme: Monthly AI allowances in USD. Easiest: leave this empty and set the numbers in the console (Governance > External Policy > Allowances), which offers only real users and departments. If you fill it here: people are Magertron USERNAMES (Users page) and departments are department NAMES (Departments page) - a name that matches nobody caps nobody. Only people listed under allowances.people are capped. To cap everyone else too, rename "_default_usd" to "default_usd" (remove the underscore). Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored. Example: "people": {"jsmith": 120}, "department_budgets_usd": {"Engineering": 5000}.
